summary.text: Lycian whom goodly Odysseus slew with the sharp bronze among Sarpedon's allies — no homonym in the atlas.

story.text: After Coeranus fell, Odysseus laid Alcandrus low with Alastor, Chromius, Halius, Noëmon, and Prytanis in the Lycian host, and yet more would he have slain had not great Hector brought terror to the Danaans.
